facts.fact: The page recommends a narration pace of about 150 words per minute for tutorial scripts.
facts.quote: Aim for a narration pace of about 150 words per minute, so a five-minute tutorial is roughly 750 words of script.

facts.fact: The page recommends a tutorial intro of 10 to 20 seconds.
The page recommends a tutorial recap of 15 to 30 seconds.
Adwave's vendor claims that Wavemaker turns pasted notes, a document, or an outline into a finished, narrated tutorial in a few minutes.
facts.quote: you get a finished, narrated tutorial in a few minutes, no editing timeline required.

facts.fact: The page describes Wavemaker as Adwave's agentic video creator.
Wavemaker's storyboard step uses one of its 21 presets.
facts.quote: Wavemaker turns the script into an AI storyboard using one of its 21 presets.

facts.fact: Wavemaker's AI vision quality-control review usually returns videos in about two to five minutes.
facts.quote: Most videos come back in about two to five minutes.

facts.fact: Each chat-editing refine in Wavemaker costs a small number of credits and takes a couple of minutes.
facts.quote: Each refine costs a small number of credits and takes a couple of minutes, so you can iterate until every step is clear.

facts.fact: Wavemaker's free plan provides 75 credits, enough to create a first video exported at 480p with a watermark.
facts.quote: Wavemaker's free plan gives you 75 credits, which is enough to create your first video, exporting at 480p with a watermark.

facts.fact: Wavemaker's free trial signup offers 75 credits with no credit card required.
facts.quote: Create your first video free with 75 credits, no credit card required.

facts.fact: The article says most good tutorials run two to eight minutes long.
facts.quote: Most good tutorials run two to eight minutes.

facts.fact: The article says a tutorial creeping past ten minutes is probably two tutorials and should be split.
